# Code Plus Software House

Code Plus Software House is a full-stack software house based in Cairo, Egypt. We build scalable, successful digital products serving startups, businesses, and enterprises across mobile, web, AI, and infrastructure.

The site is fully bilingual, supporting English and Thai.

- English: https://codeplusdev.com/en
- Thai: https://codeplusdev.com/th

---

## Services

We offer a range of professional software development services:

- **Mobile App Development**: Native Swift/Kotlin and Flutter cross-platform applications.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/mobile
- **Web Platforms & E-Commerce**: High-performance React/Next.js web applications.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/web
- **UI/UX Design & Branding**: Beautiful and premium user experiences.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/design
- **Backend & Infrastructure**: Scalable backends, APIs, database architectures, and cloud hosting.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/backend
- **ERP & Business Systems**: Custom business automation software and management portals.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/erp
- **AI & Smart Solutions**: LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and smart agents.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/ai
- **Industry-Specific Platforms**: Purpose-built industry platforms and systems.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/industry
- **Security, Consulting & Support**: Cyber-security posture, consulting, and support agreements.
  - Path: https://codeplusdev.com/en/services/security
